text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — Q2 forecast came in from growth. They expect a ~2.8x increase in vector-ranking queries May-Jul. Need a quick proposal for pool mix (realtime vs batch) and regional allocations.

Raj Patel: Ack. Do we have the traffic shape? bursty or steady?

Mia Chen: Burstier during promo windows (weekday mornings PT). Median qps +1.6x, 95th up to 3.2x. P95 latency requirement for realtime paths is 120ms target (hard SLO 200ms).

Olivia Park: Current infra: 120 T4s in us-west, 40 A10gs in eu-central for private customers, and 30 spare gpus in ap-south via cloud partner. Realtime pool is sticky nodes, batch is preemptible/spot autoscale.

Samir Gupta: Quick numbers I ran: to keep realtime P95 ~120ms with our model (8k token kv-cache typical) we need roughly 70 T4-equivalent GPUs at steady 60% utilization during peak. Batch needs are ~10k GPU-hours/week for nightly reranks.

Mia Chen: Proposal draft: split 70% realtime / 30% batch during promo windows, baseline 50/50 off-peak. Pre-warm 15% of realtime pool to avoid cold-start tails. Route EU realtime to dedicated A10gs but limit concurrency to avoid network egress spikes.

Raj Patel: Sounds sensible. What about cost delta if we move 10% of realtime to quantized variants (int8) vs full fp16?

Samir Gupta: Back-of-envelope: int8 reduces per-token GPU time ~1.6x on our runtime. For 70% realtime split that saves ~22% GPU-hours and ~18% cost after accounting for slightly lower throughput on long-context requests. Risk: small quality regression on ~4% of reranks.

Olivia Park: EU region note: we only have 40 A10gs, some reserved for enterprise. If growth hits, we need cross-region fallback (route to us-west) which adds ~30-50ms network tail and extra egress cost. Need policy for fallback vs soft-degrade.

Mia Chen: I sketched autoscale policy to test for next 6 weeks. Paste: 
```
realtime_policy:
  min_nodes: 12
  prewarm_margin: 0.15
  target_p95_ms: 120
  scale_cooldown: 60s
  max_nodes: 120
batch_policy:
  window: 4h
  max_concurrent_jobs: 40
  spot_fallback: true
```

Raj Patel: Two asks: 1) can eng-platform simulate the promo-day peak with 3.2x qps and verify P95 under simulated network faults? 2) finance: get rough monthly cost delta for converting 20% batch hours to reserved capacity.

Olivia Park: I'll run a dry simulation targeting the prewarm + scale policy and post graphs to #eng-metrics. infra-bot: please schedule a smoke-run for Tuesday 03:00 UTC.

infra-bot: scheduled smoke-run: 1779170000. Test will run 30m, include simulated 100ms network jitter and 10% spot termination.

Samir Gupta: If the smoke-run passes, my recommendation is: enable int8 on 20% of realtime routes (low-risk customer segments), keep EU soft-fallback enabled, and procure an extra 12 A10g-equivalent slots for June surge (reserve for 3 months).

Mia Chen: Good thread — can everyone ack and I'll fold into a short runbook and send to product for promo coordination? :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: Ack.

Olivia Park: Ack, will attach simulation output when ready.

Samir Gupta: Ack.

Mia Chen: Filing follow-up: I'll add a small prompt set eval to monitor quality drift for int8 variants during the smoke-run.
